tools.name: di_search_docs
tools.description: Performs vector/semantic search over the official di-framework documentation, automatically scoped to the installed framework version in the workspace (or latest).

query.description: The search query or concept (e.g. "scoped child container", "http middleware", "event subscribers")

version.description: Optional version override (e.g. "v4.2", "latest"). Defaults to the installed version in projectPath; fallback reasons are returned.

projectPath.description: Absolute target project/workspace directory; defaults to the MCP process working directory.

maxHits.description: Maximum number of doc hits to return (defaults to 5)

tools.name: di_scaffold_provider
tools.description: Scaffolds a @Container() service class verified with core 6.0.3 (latest) and 6.0.1.

serviceName.description: Name of the service (e.g. AuthService, PaymentService)

frameworkVersion.description: Resolved target core version; scaffold supports 6.0.3 (default) and 6.0.1

tools.name: di_validate_tokens
tools.description: Checks caller-supplied name/hasProvider assertions only; does not inspect application registrations. Use di_inspect_graph for source inspection.

tools.name: di_window
tools.description: Expands context around a matched topic section cursor (slug, chunk id, or index) by neighbor radius, returning targeted adjacent sections without dumping the whole doc.

cursor.description: The section slug, chunk ID, or index to expand around (e.g. "property-injection", "docs_events__subscribers", "0")

projectPath.description: Absolute target project/workspace directory. Pass the search hit window.version to preserve its snapshot.

radius.description: Number of neighbor sections to include before and after (defaults to 1)

tools.name: di_inspect_graph
tools.description: Statically inspects file-local @di-framework/core 6.0.x Container registrations, explicit Component injection and inline factory resolves. Reports cycles, missing registrations, source locations and incomplete analysis for unsupported patterns; never executes source.

files.description: List of file paths to analyze for DI registrations and resolutions
